instructions: Compare the changed clause with the linked clause. Choose contradicts when the changed behavior conflicts with the target clause or its non-goal. Choose overlaps when both clauses describe the same behavior or surface. Choose oversteps when the changed clause adds a behavior beyond the target clause's stated boundary. Choose unrelated when the clauses share no behavior or boundary that needs a review flag. Do not flag a merely related clause.

labels.name: contradicts
labels.description: The changed clause conflicts with the target clause or with a non-goal in the same spec.

input.before: The base end is the commit whose spec bytes are compared, which is the selected base or, for a spec absent there, its first committed seed.
input.after: The base end is the selected base commit; a spec absent there is entirely new, as focus defines.
input.target: The baseline response retains the selected commit in base and identifies the actual HTML snapshot in htmlBase; a file absent from the selected base uses its stable first committed seed, or null when still uncommitted.

input.before: Only human clicks write spool events.
input.after: The agent automatically writes a move event.
input.target: Only a human click on Move comment here writes, using existing events.

labels.name: overlaps
labels.description: The changed clause and target clause describe the same behavior, surface, or responsibility.

input.before: The server stores one judgment record for each question.
input.target: The records are the cache: each is keyed by a hash of its question inputs and set version.

input.before: A confident flag adds a label.
input.after: A confident flag adds a label on the changed clause.
input.target: A confident flag adds a small label on the changed clause.

labels.name: oversteps
labels.description: The changed clause extends beyond the target clause's stated scope or boundary without directly contradicting it.

input.before: Reading view dims internal clauses in the browser.
input.after: Reading view changes provider thresholds on the server.
input.target: The browser runtime owns reading view and consumes the route.

input.after: The route edits the spec when a label is confident.
input.target: No suggestion edits a spec; only a human click writes.

labels.name: unrelated
labels.description: The changed clause and target clause share no behavior or boundary that needs a review flag.

input.before: The cache key includes the source revision.
input.after: The cache key includes the source revision and set version.
input.target: Mobile markers stay visible at narrow widths.

input.before: The page shows a comment label.
input.after: The page shows a comment label with text.
input.target: The compared base determines the Git focus.
